{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert `revenue` to numeric: remove commas and cast to float
data['revenue'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders from loyal customers
filtered_data = data[(data['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (data['status'] == 'completed')]

# Identify and remove the QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = filtered_data['revenue'] == 999999.99
qa_count = qa_mask.sum()

# Remove QA orders
filtered_data_clean = filtered_data[~qa_mask]

# Compute mean revenue on cleaned data
mean_revenue = filtered_data_clean['revenue'].mean()

# Output the result
print(f"Number of QA orders removed: {qa_count}")
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders from loyal customers (after removing QA orders): {mean_revenue}")

# Return the value for submission
mean_revenue"}
